successCriteria.description: src/shared/error-types.ts exports NotFoundError, ValidationError, and ConflictError classes, each extending native Error, each with an optional `details` property of type `unknown`

src/shared/base-repository.ts exports a generic abstract class BaseRepository<T> that accepts a pg Pool via constructor injection, exposes a protected query(text: string, params: unknown[]) method delegating to pool.query, and declares an abstract findById(id: string): Promise<T | null>

tests/unit/shared/error-types.test.ts verifies: each error class can be instantiated with a message, each is an instance of Error, each carries details when provided, and each has the correct name property

tests/unit/shared/base-repository.test.ts verifies: BaseRepository cannot be instantiated directly (abstract), a concrete subclass can be instantiated with a mock pool, query delegates to pool.query with correct arguments, and findById must be implemented by subclass

constraints: Must read src/shared/db/connection.ts before generating — the BaseRepository constructor must accept the pg Pool type exported from that file
The `details` property on error classes must use `unknown` type, not `any` (HARNESS constraint no-any)
Jest unit tests must follow the existing pattern from tests/unit/shared/types.test.ts (describe/it blocks, no external test dependencies beyond Jest)
BaseRepository must be abstract — cannot be instantiated directly; findById must be abstract forcing subclasses to implement it
outOfScope: Any repository implementations beyond the abstract BaseRepository — concrete repositories (LeavePolicyRepository, LeaveBalanceRepository, LeaveRequestRepository) are deferred to Phases 3–5
Database migrations, table creation, or schema definitions — this phase only provides shared utility classes
Audit logging, RBAC enforcement, or input validation — these are handled in later phases (service/controller layers)
